annotations.title: US spot Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and XRP ETF daily flows

description: Call this when the user asks about Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana or XRP spot ETF flows: daily net inflows or outflows, cumulative flow since launch, or total net assets of the US spot ETFs (IBIT, FBTC, ETHA, XRPC and the rest). Returns one row per finalized US trading day and asset with net inflow, total net assets, cumulative inflow since launch and value traded, all in USD. History by asset: BTC and ETH since 2025-05-20, SOL since 2025-10-28, XRP since 2026-09-08.

asset.description: Filter to one asset (BTC, ETH, SOL or XRP). Omit for all.

days.description: How many most recent trading days to return (default 10).

name: get_etf_flows
